scenario.title: BATTLE OF LAKE KHASAN - 2 AUG 1938
intro.text:
BATTLE OF LAKE KHASAN - 2 AUG 1938

Lake Khasan, Far East of Soviet Union

The sneaky Japanese attacked and beaten our border troops on the Bezymyannaya and Zaozyornaya hills. Attack the Japanese with superior power and recapture the territories we deserve!

ORDERS
After 9 turns control 7/6/5 VH for a BV/V/TV.

CORE (recommended)
2x Tank (+1)
2x Infantry (+2)
1x Reconnaissance
1x Artillery (+1)
header.act: ACT I — LESSONS BEFORE THE GREAT WAR
header.location: Lake Khasan, Soviet Far East — 2 August 1938
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.reaction-briliant.text: Illescas fell before the Spanish infantry expected to leave Seseña. The photographs reached Moscow first; the reports about scattered companies arrived later.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.reaction-victory.text: The towns south of Madrid were taken, but neither armour nor infantry can claim it acted alone. That has not stopped both camps from trying.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.reaction-tactical.text: Spain gave us no clean demonstration—only damaged tanks, exhausted infantry, and enough success for every theorist to blame the other arm.
line.callback-choice-a.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.callback-choice-a.text: Illescas made speed look like an argument no staff college could answer. The tank officers have quoted your order ever since; today they expect another road to open for them.
line.callback-choice-b.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.callback-choice-b.text: In Spain you kept the tanks tied to guns and infantry. Antonov still calls it a missed demonstration. The men who reached the final objective together call it something else.
line.scene-0.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.scene-0.text: I found the photograph from Spain in the transport file. Two faces have been cut out, neatly enough that the scissors took part of Antonov's sleeve.
line.scene-1.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.scene-1.text: Put it away, Anna. This headquarters has orders, a border, and a list of names it is permitted to use.
line.scene-2.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.scene-2.text: Survey stakes disappear into the mud as quickly as the engineers plant them. From the observation post the hills look close; every approach between here and their slopes is wet, exposed, and already registered by enemy guns.
line.decision.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.decision.text: The border must be restored, but a map line does not tell us how to reach it. We can mass everything against the heights, or spend precious hours preparing lanes through the marsh and coordinating the batteries.
line.decision.choice.mass-the-assault.te: Mass the striking force and keep pressure on both heights without pause.
line.decision.choice.mass-the-assault.hi: Give infantry 18 experience and artillery 12 experience, and gain 50 prestige for accepting the immediate assault timetable.
Let engineers mark firm approaches and artillery register before the infantry moves.
Attach an experienced eight-strength 1936 engineer detachment; the special transport and equipment cost 60 prestige.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.choice-a-0.text: The attack will not stop to reorganise on the lower slopes. Reserves follow the first success before the defenders can shift between the hills.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.choice-a-1.text: Then the casualty clerks get the true unit rolls before the first wave. I will not let missing names become another neat absence in a file.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.choice-b-0.text: The first wave waits for marked lanes and observed fire. We lose surprise in minutes, but not battalions in unmarked marsh.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.choice-b-1.text: I will put the engineers' reports above the timetable. If a patrol finds a false lane, the battalion stops there—even if headquarters has already announced that it moved.
line.post-0.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.post-0.text: The photograph goes back in the transport file. The engineers' reports and the unit rolls stay on top.
